attempts.why: Media query keeps 3 columns on mobile (375px) making cards unreadably narrow instead of collapsing to 1 column.

selfVerify.reason: Grid now collapses to 1 column on 375px: #grid is 375px wide and each .card is 327px (375 minus 24px gutters) stacked vertically (y 559,894,1258...), not 3 narrow columns. No horizontal overflow: docScrollWidth (375) equals viewport width (375) and no element exceeds viewport; table overflow is contained via overflow:auto on #tablewrap.
